黙る.note: だまる: る = the monk's RULE of silence → to be silent. だます: す = SWINDLE → to trick.

騙す.note: だます: す = SWINDLE → to trick. だまる: る = the monk's RULE of silence → to be silent.

叫ぶ.note: さけぶ: ぶ = "BOO!" → to shout. さける: dodging the SACKER → to avoid.

避ける.note: さける: dodging the SACKER → to avoid. さけぶ: ぶ = "BOO!" → to shout.

悲しい.note: かなしい: a can with "nashi" (no pear) → sad. かなり: the loud CANARY → considerably.

かなり.note: かなり: the loud CANARY → considerably, quite. かなしい: a can with "nashi" → sad.

三日.note: みっか: か = the day the MITTENS dry → three days / the 3rd. みっつ: MEAT-SUshi → three things.

三つ.note: みっつ: MEAT-SUshi → three things. みっか: か = the day the MITTENS dry → three days / the 3rd.

肩.note: かた: a KARATE chop to the shoulder → shoulder. かたい: the CAT's EYE on a frozen fish → hard.

硬い.note: かたい: the CAT's EYE (い) on a frozen fish → hard. かた: a KARATE chop → shoulder.
